name: Astrid Finance
report: The attacker exploited the withdraw function in the ADC protocol by first manipulating the calcStepIncome function with an inflated value_ parameter (36_099_999_999_999_999_900) to improperly update the withdrawable balance, then calling the withdraw function to drain approximately 20 ETH from the contract.
report_zh: 攻击者利用ADC协议中的withdraw函数，首先通过一个膨胀的value_参数（36_099_999_999_999_999_900）操纵calcStepIncome函数，不当更新可提取余额，随后调用withdraw函数从合约中盗取约20 ETH。
